title: CoordinationPolicy
description:
Bounds and scheduling for an `AgentGroup`. Stored on the parent run's metadata
and enforced by the runtime when creating child tasks.

max_child_retries.description: Bounded retries of a failed child task (not of uncertain external writes).

max_delegations.description: Maximum children created from one parent (default 16).

max_depth.description: Maximum parent→child nesting, inclusive of the first child (default 4).

prevent_cycles.description: Reject a child whose agent name already appears in the ancestor chain.

require_parent_verification.description: Parent goal is verified independently of child execution status.

CoordinationMode.description: How a coordinator schedules child tasks.

FailureMode.description: Failure handling after a child ends unsuccessfully.
